visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide, eye-level shot of a grand stage decorated with vibrant neon signs shaped like stars and hearts, alongside the CPBL logo. A man wearing a black shirt walks from left to right across the platform while white stairs are visible in the foreground. (2) The scene shifts to a handheld walking shot following a man in a white t-shirt as he moves through a vast indoor ballroom. The space is densely packed with numerous round banquet tables covered in red cloths and surrounded by guests. (3) A close-up focuses on a red tablecloth where several blue aluminum cans of Taiwan Beer are clustered together. Next to them sits a printed name tag featuring the text "方昶詠" and the CPBL 2025 event branding. (4) The main character, a man with neatly styled dark hair, speaks directly into the camera in a selfie-style composition. He wears a white t-shirt and a branded lanyard around his neck, gesturing enthusiastically as he describes the event atmosphere. (5) The screen displays a collage of professional logos from various baseball teams and corporate sponsors, including the Rakuten Monkeys and Dragons. This is followed by a clear insert shot of a printed baseball lineup card. (6) A middle-aged man in a black polo shirt stands on the stage, pointing and speaking into a handheld microphone while the audience watches from their tables in the brightly lit indoor setting. (7) A female host dressed in a blue top and white skirt addresses the crowd from the stage. As she speaks, a pressurized smoke machine releases a thick vertical plume of white smoke, creating a dramatic visual effect. (8) A group of six female cheerleaders, clad in matching white and pink athletic uniforms, perform a synchronized high-energy dance routine on the stage. Their movements are sharp and coordinated under the flashing stage lights. (9) The camera pans across the seated audience, showing various individuals clapping and smiling. Many people are holding up their smartphones to capture photos and videos of the performances on the main stage. (10) The cheerleaders continue their performance with expressive facial gestures and dynamic arm movements. The background remains the brightly lit, neon-decorated stage, emphasizing the festive and high-arousal nature of the press conference event. (11) In the final shot, the main character is seated in the interior of a vehicle. He wears large gold-rimmed sunglasses, looks directly at the camera with a smile, and gives a confident thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a complex bed of ambient indoor noise, featuring a distinct room tone with reverberation typical of a large convention hall. Distant, indistinct human chatter and the low hum of air conditioning are present throughout this introductory segment. (2) A male voice enters the mix, exhibiting a clear, friendly, and highly animated tone. His speech rate is fast with a rising pitch contour, indicating high arousal and excitement. A mid-tempo electronic pop BGM swells in the background, featuring synthesized chords and a steady rhythm. (3) The music transitions into a more rhythmic hip-hop style with a prominent kick drum and percussive transients. A female singer's voice is heard within the music track, delivering English lyrics with a smooth, professional vocal quality and moderate rhythmic intensity. (4) A high-pitched female voice, presumably a stage host, speaks with projected loudness and sharp articulation. This is immediately followed by a short, broadband 'whoosh' sound from a smoke machine, which has a fast attack and decaying spectral noise floor. (5) The BGM becomes the dominant audio layer, characterized by a strong beat and high spectral brightness. The sound of a large crowd clapping in unison creates a dense layer of percussive transients, overlapping with the rhythmic cheering and excited vocalizations. (6) The video concludes with the male voice returning in a much quieter setting. The acoustic environment shifts to a car interior, characterized by low-frequency engine hum and muffled urban traffic noise, while his tone remains calm and satisfied.
